about: Inputs of the m3/orientation-sampling bundle (emit.py): orix.sampling.get_sample_fundamental and get_sample_local with the cubochoric method. Resolutions in degrees; point groups by orix name; local centres as Bunge Euler angles in degrees (lab to crystal). rows_per_case bounds the rows a bundle keeps of a large sample: every stride-th rotation in orix's order, stride = ceil(count / rows_per_case), and the last one.
